summary: This is an 8-K filed under Item 8.01 (Other Events) by M2i Global, Inc. on June 23, 2026. It provides a business update discussing progress on a Critical Mineral Repository at Hawthorne Army Depot, expansion of commercial pipeline with offtake arrangements, federal engagement initiatives, and identified capital investment opportunities. No specific transaction, activist campaign, or special situation is announced. The filing is a routine current report updating shareholders on ongoing operations without any defined deal terms, structural changes, or binding commitments. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event.
